extra.reason: Scaffold done: pnpm 12.21 workspace (packageManager pinned; corepack), TS ~6.0.3 strict with project refs (tsc -b at root; packages composite + emitDeclarationOnly to dist/), vitest ^4.1.12 per package (v4 not v5: @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers peers vitest ^4.1, and v5 drops Node 20), eslint 10 + typescript-eslint strict + prettier at root. TS 7 skipped: typescript-eslint supports <6.1. Packages export ./src/index.ts directly (no build step needed by consumers). tsconfig.base has types: [] and lib ES2022 only — web must add DOM lib, worker must add workers types. Root docs (SPEC/CONTRACTS/CLAUDE/AGENTS.md) are in .prettierignore. dev/seed are echo placeholders. Skeleton beads should replace each package's build script (vite/wrangler) and may drop emitDeclarationOnly as needed.

Merged to main. zod schemas (strict) + inferred types, RecordBody/StoredRecord/OpenedRecord, ParsedEventSchema, hand-written eventsJsonSchema (root is an array: 2jd.2 may need to wrap it in an object for tool/structured output), luxon time helpers; fixtures in packages/shared/test/fixtures.ts. Ambiguous fall-back times resolve to luxon's choice (standard time).

Merged to main. crypto.ts per CONTRACTS §4 (HKDF with no salt, now written into CONTRACTS). vectors.json + sealWithEphemeral (test-only, exported) let btp.2 re-run vectors in the Workers runtime. shared tsconfig now has lib ES2022+DOM.

PR #1 merged. Hono app + empty routers at CONTRACTS §5 paths, D1/R2/ASSETS bindings, 0001_init.sql, tests in Workers runtime via @cloudflare/vitest-plugin (CONTRACTS §1 updated). pnpm dev does NOT apply local D1 migrations; btp.5 must. compatibility_date pinned to 2026-08-01 (workerd limit).
PR #3: allowBuilds esbuild+workerd in pnpm-workspace.yaml; pnpm install now exits 0.
PR #4: web api.ts imports types from @planfully/shared; bundle unchanged.

PR #5 merged. requireTrip middleware on /api/trips/:id/* sets c.get('trip') (TripEnv in api/auth.ts); sub-routers should use Hono<TripEnv>. db/trips.ts: TripRow camelCase, getTripByAddress case-insensitive. next_seq starts at 0 = last assigned seq; btp.3 must do next_seq = next_seq + 1 RETURNING so seqs start at 1.

PR #7 merged. parseEmail(email,{roster,today,apiKey,client?}) in worker/src/llm; ParseError.reason no_api_key|api_error|invalid_output|refusal. Linear HTML tokenizer (2 MB cap), base64-size attachment limits, root-array eventsJsonSchema kept (verify live in 2jd.6). email/types.ts has ParsedEmail only; 2jd.1 adds EmailRoute.
